title: Arena settings
description: Versioned settings document for an arena instance (ADR-24), stored in arenas.settings. Unlike elo_settings (a date-keyed series) these settings are date-independent: changing them affects every match of the arena. v2 moved the rating catch-up parameters (earned_min, earned_max, tau) out of the newbie league into the top-level catch_up object: the catch-up is driven by the starting_rating vs starting_elo gap and applies to every arena regardless of leagues (a no-op while rating >= elo). What remains league-specific is goal_gap — how big the gap keeps a player in the newbie league. leagues lists the leagues that exist in the arena in promotion order; an empty array means no leagues (league is NULL on settlements), and a single league is rejected — either none, or at least two. v1 carried no entity references, so no x-entity-id marking is needed.

starting_rating.description: Initial display rating for players with no prior settlement in this arena.

catch_up.description: Rating catch-up parameters (ADR-03): while a player's rating is below their elo, wins earn between earned_min and earned_max rating points, the exact amount scaling with the gap; above elo, stakes are amplified the same way. A no-op when the starting rating equals the starting elo (rating mirrors elo exactly).

leagues.description: Either no leagues at all (players render as one caption-less list), or at least two in promotion order — a single league is rejected: it would only rename the list's caption, and a lone newbie league would leave the «wins needed» hints pointing at a promotion that does not exist.

goal_gap.description: Player stays in newbie while elo - rating > goal_gap.

matches_6m.description: Matches within the last 6 months required to reach/stay in elite.

matches_2m.description: Matches within the last 2 months required to reach/stay in elite.
